native_report.scope: Fresh training episodes at the saved curriculum clock. Native Gaussian act/process/GAE only. No optimizer update, no checkpoint written, no mid-rollout replay or fixed-case acceptance claim.
native_report.interpretation: Group-conditioned credit and noise moments are descriptive score estimates before PPO clipping/epochs, not a unique cause or guaranteed update direction. Post-warmup populations explicitly exclude episode age <=1s. No optimization or learning/curriculum clock advance occurred.

interpretation: The actual native learning mask and Gaussian/GAE are used at the saved 2176 clock, twelve 96-tick rollouts, 512 fresh episodes with saved RNG. Optimizer update and step are guarded to raise. Actor/critic/17Adam state trees are identical afterward; no checkpoint or PPO consumption added.

Post-warmup command partitions are defined by visible pre-step commands, not group-name guesses. Hard commands (>1m/s or >4rad/s) occupy 25.75% of eligible transitions and 73.37% of normalized advantage second moment. Basic commands (<=0.5m/s and <=1rad/s) occupy 59.18% and 18.33%. Overlapping terminal-window partitions are separately labelled and not added to these fractions.

The 0.48s before an observed episode end accounts for 0.538% of post-warmup samples and 30.36% of advantage second moment. This is descriptive of this six-second fresh-episode probe, not an independent-sample significance test or a learning-cause proof. The final probe edge has no future observations.

Reward components are actual native per-second payments; group score moments are before PPO clipping and epochs. Values are not accepted behavior, guaranteed update directions, or evidence that suppressing difficult groups necessarily fixes learning.
